note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive (Hutong NYC explicitly so), and August targets step up again, so weekly and YTD variances read heavily negative by design. The portfolio booked 431 GA4 bookings against a 1,101 blended weekly target, down 6.3 percent week on week and 30.8 percent below last year. Aqua NYC was the only venue up week on week (+3.9 percent) and its users are 21.5 percent ahead of last year, so its gap is conversion, not traffic: 3.6 percent this year against 6.9 percent last. Hutong Miami gave back last week’s gain, down 28.6 percent to 80. Hutong NYC is traffic-constrained, users -27.0 percent year on year. Read this with the covers report: both US Hutongs moved their Google Reserve booking provider to OpenTable in March, so part of the year-on-year fall in GA4 and in Google Reserve covers is a routing change rather than lost demand.
